_comment: Versioned wearable registry (v2): each existing shop id -> its isolated PNG (web/public/assets/hashling/wearables, extension/assets/hashling/wearables), source size, physical-content alphaBounds [x0,y0,x1,y1] from the asset pack manifest, render layer and mount. layers (back to front): behindPet, pet, frontStraps (code-native svg), frontAccessory, collar, hat. mount.anchor = frame from pets.json; mount.at = fraction of the alphaBounds box that lands on the anchor; mount.w = canonical units spanned by the alpha width (aspect preserved); dx/dy canonical offsets; rot degrees; mount.span = [anchorA, anchorB] puts the origin at their midpoint with unit = distance/100 and the line's rotation; mount.mask = fade this fraction of the left/right ends (collar wraps behind side fur); mount.byStage = per-stage overrides. Run `python scripts/sync_items.py` after editing to copy into extension/hashling.js.
